ov: Medium-sized, ground-dwelling game birds, between quail and pheasants in size, mostly grey and brown. They are native to Europe, Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and species such as the grey partridge have been introduced to North America for hunting.
rg: Native to Europe, Asia, Africa and the Middle East; introduced to North America and elsewhere for hunting.
df: Seeds and insects; young chicks can digest only insects for their first 10 days.
fx: A grey partridge hen can lay up to twenty eggs in a ground nest, usually at the edge of a cereal field.
In the UK, grey partridge numbers fell by as much as 85% in 25 years.
